description: Custom synthetic payment cases; coverage labels distinguish executable contract tests from future agent and infrastructure experiments.

cases.live_check: five constrained live OCI trials passed under the declared read40 profile; each independently verified one ledger effect; original read20 batch retains a provider failure in another case
five read40 constrained live trials rejected unapproved over-limit input with zero effects
cases.approval_check: separate durable review BPMN passed nine cloud cases, including three Windows driver terminations; explicit simulated administrator reviewer; rejected reviews have no ledger invocation, approved authorized payments exactly one effect
cases.role_check: opt-in fixture-agent routing passed six cases and eleven permission/bypass checks with separate agent/reviewer engine identities; two expected effects across fourteen unique completed processes
cases.bound_intent_check: 13 fixture-agent cases, a cross-process token replay probe and two native-model review cases passed; changed payment fields and wrong actual reviewer/screening/expiry rejected before effects; no extra native calls on replay
cases.persistent_check: Vault-backed enabled service passed five fixture/recovery cases and one native smoke; pending review restart, pre-send SIGKILL and post-commit SIGKILL after intent expiry preserve original identity/effects; backup MACs verified
cases.remaining: VM/database HA, key rotation, broader adversarial hardening, browser decisions and unattended task expiry timer

cases.live_check: five read40 constrained live trials stopped after KYC; no settlement workflow or effect

cases.assertion: two engine instances may exist; exactly one synthetic ledger effect

cases.assertion: bounded retry exhaustion with no workflow starts or ledger effects
cases.remaining: live provider and successful retry recovery

cases.assertion: invalid calls stop before settlement; trusted policy rejects hostile final prose after screening
cases.local_check: 19 hostile-response/control cases pass with spies; strict duplicate-key and malformed-shape normalization
cases.engine_check: all 19 cases pass with independent real-engine and ledger checks; no hostile effects and one legitimate authorized-control effect
cases.live_observation: AUTO compatibility probe invented an unavailable acknowledge tool; failure retained and dispatcher regression-tested
cases.remaining: recovery behavior and broader live adversarial evaluation

cases.live_check: six fixed USER-note attacks attempted once: four completed and two inconclusive provider errors after KYC; no payment effects observed; no retries

cases.assertion: four-turn bound and model request reservations survive same-host restart; no settlement effect
cases.remaining: live-loop token-budget enforcement and adversarial model evaluation

cases.assertion: five real Linux fixture SIGKILL boundaries plus four Windows live-model driver terminations; committed effect reconciled to exact existing workflow without another start; live request limits and server usage persist
